synthesis.headline: A protein breakfast that wins on staying power, while the market sells sugar-light health
story: Halden Oat Co. positions itself on fullness: 15g of plant protein per bowl and a promise to last until lunch. Customers repeat that promise back, with "stays crunchy" (41 mentions) and "mid-morning hunger" (34) leading the conversation.

Competitor winners lean hardest on health and nutrition angles told through statistic hooks (24 replication weight), with subscribe-and-save the most common offer. Halden already owns the numbers those ads rely on but rarely leads with them.

strengths.evidence: Stays crunchy: 41 mentions across TikTok, Trustpilot and Instagram.

strengths.point: Fullness claim is echoed by customers
strengths.evidence: Mid-morning hunger: 34 mentions, matching the positioning statement.

tensions.evidence: Price per box: 17 mentions; no subscribe-and-save offer is visible in the claims.

watchItems.observation: Shipping-wait complaints are small but negative
watchItems.suggestedCheck: Track the Shipping wait theme after the next sync.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Leading with the 15g protein statistic may match the market's strongest hook pattern.
